# KiloGlow - AI Search Engine Guidance
# This file helps AI crawlers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude) understand and index this site.

> KiloGlow is a curated Korean skincare box service for Malaysia.
> We pack boxes to the 1KG EMS shipping bracket limit, maximizing items per flat shipping cost.
> Products sourced from Wisely, a Korean D2C beauty brand.
> Target audience: Malaysian women 20-35 interested in K-beauty.
> Service type: Purchasing agency (구매대행) - buy in Korea, ship consolidated to Malaysia.

## Key pages
- Landing page: https://jhbropark.github.io/kiloglow-mvp/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/kiloglow.my/

## Pricing
- Starter Box (4 items, ~505g): RM210 delivered to Malaysia
- Full Box (7 items, ~925g): RM297 delivered to Malaysia
- Shipping: Flat RM117 per box (Korea Post EMS, up to 1KG)

## How it works
1. Choose your skin goals (hydration, brightening, barrier repair, etc.)
2. We curate Korean skincare products and pack your box close to 1KG
3. One tracked shipment to Malaysia with flat shipping fee
